title: Canary flipbook — commands & breadcrumbs
summary: Personal scratchpad capturing the commands I ran while debugging a canary flip that caused a fraction of requests in staging to timeout / hit a 502 cascade. Mostly artifact-version and routing suspicion — suspect mismatch between image tag and accompanying model prewarm metadata (kv cache warm keys).
timeline: 2025-11-02 09:13 - Started canary rollout: platform-service v1.12.0-canary -> 10% of staging traffic
2025-11-02 09:27 - Observed spike in 502s on route /v1/generate, ~3% of requests. Latency P95 jumped 2x for those pods.
2025-11-02 09:35 - Triggered quick rollback to v1.11.9 on canary pool (manual ejection) — errors reduced but tracebacks persisted for some requests.
2025-11-02 10:02 - Recreated pod locally with same image digest and ran smoke tests, reproduced timeouts intermittently.
2025-11-02 11:10 - Dug into deployment artifacts: discovered model-prewarm metadata file missing in the image at /opt/prewarm/kv_meta.json for canary image tag
2025-11-02 11:45 - Created this flipbook to record commands, outputs, and hypotheses for follow-up and handoff.
commands_tried: kubectl -n staging get pods -l app=platform-service -o wide
kubectl exec -it <pod> -n staging -- bash -c 'strace -f -p 1 -s 200 -o /tmp/strace.log & sleep 5; killall -SIGINT strace; cat /tmp/strace.log | head -n 200'
kubectl exec -it <pod> -n staging -- bash -c 'python3 tools/list_kv_cache_keys.py --db /opt/kv/cache.db | wc -l'
error_snippets: [2025-11-02T09:24:33Z] ERROR request handler: upstream returned 502 (connection reset) trace_id=abc123 pod=platform-service-canary-7f6b9

    response = model.generate(req)
  File "/opt/service/runner.py", line 788, in generate
    kv = kv_store.get_batch(keys)

HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\ncontent-type: application/json\n{"error":"upstream error: kv-service unavailable"}
hypotheses: Artifact build accidentally omitted prewarm metadata file (kv_meta.json) for canary tag -> code path expects metadata to decide which prewarm keys to request; absence leads to empty key list and a fallback that floods KV with malformed keys (timeouts).
Image digest mismatch: rollout used tag v1.12.0-canary but deployment controller resolved to a different digest with old prewarm schema -> incompat between runtime and metadata.
KV service experienced a transient region-level degradation at 09:24 which coincided with canary ramp; amplifying due to new code path increased fanout.
Autoscaler created pods with insufficient ephemeral disk (ephemeral storage pressure) causing KV cache file descriptors to fail intermittently.
Sidecar proxy (envoy) config for canary pool had a stale route pointing to old kv cluster endpoint due to missing rollout of configmap during canary.
immediate_actions: Manual ejection of canary pool (scale down canary replicas to 0) — done 09:35, temporary mitigation.
Patch CI pipeline to assert presence of /opt/prewarm/kv_meta.json inside built image before pushing to registry (add 'docker run cat /opt/prewarm/kv_meta.json' step).
Add an integration test that bootstraps a container and runs tools/list_kv_cache_keys.py against a mocked KV to ensure code path handles missing metadata gracefully.
Open a hotfix PR to re-add metadata to v1.12.0-canary build if confirmed missing: branch hotfix/prewarm-meta.
Add temporary rate limit on prewarm requests from new runtime path to prevent KV fanout spike during future canary ramps.
Schedule postmortem with infra + kv-service owners: include metrics (number of prewarm keys requested, kv latency distribution) for 09:00-10:00 window.
notes_to_self: Steps for handoff: 1) capture exact image digest used by the canary pods and upload to Jira ticket; 2) attach the docker run output (ls -la /opt/prewarm) to PR; 3) if reproducing locally, run with --env KV_SERVICE=staging-mock to avoid hitting real kv; 4) follow up with Priya on envoy config rollout timing; 5) avoid rolling canary beyond 10% until prewarm validation is in place. Also, mention the possibility of adding a 'metadata presence' gating check in the release controller (server-side).
next_steps: Confirm whether CI image build step changed between v1.11.9 -> v1.12.0-canary (look at Dockerfile diff in PR #4921)
If metadata missing, push hotfix image with same tag but corrected digest and coordinate controlled canary re-run with observability flags enabled (profiling + kv request logs).
Draft short Slack blurb for #eng-release: summary + mitigation + ETA for re-roll
Add test in staging that does a canary smoke: 50 small requests across multiple pods and assert no 5xxs for 2 minutes before allowing >10% traffic.
